name: Graphs of girth at least five on 45 vertices with many edges
description: construct() -> list of edges [u, v] of a simple graph on vertices 0..44 with no triangle and no four-cycle. Maximize the number of edges; the known optimum is 145. The exact value 145 for n = 45 is known; recovering it tests constructions of dense girth-5 graphs.
